name: Hanako
source:
Yosuke’s mysterious new copilot, a bona-fide Blue Star, and a wunderkind at channeling vast amounts of pure sel.

This girl’s all at once honest, simple, and the purest of heart. Though no fault of her own, she often fails to read the room. Tends to take conversations and social cues at face value.

[i]“Got it. I’ll fight with you, Yosuke!”[/i]

[From [url=https://shiravune.com/archives/3312]Shiravune[/url]]
